generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 vertical master illustration for an original layered interactive tarot card, Wheel of Fortune, theme 潮汐轮盘. The input image is reference only for ornate painterly celestial-tarot quality and core iconography; create a new scene without any border, text, lettering, or copied framing.
Primary request: One precise front-facing perfectly circular golden tidal wheel in the upper-center, with exactly eight broad spokes—count exactly eight, no extra spokes. Four fixed seasonal medallions form one rigid group around it: upper-left contains spring flowers, upper-right contains a simple golden sun, lower-left contains autumn leaves, lower-right contains a snowy pine forest. The medallions are not portraits and do not rotate. Beneath, a deep-blue tidal pool and a complete X-shaped stone path fan out from the lower foreground and disappear naturally into shallow water. The wheel may float above the pool.
Style/medium: detailed luminous painterly fantasy, premium tarot collectible art, crisp concentric metal engraving and water texture. No rainbow foil baked into art.
Composition/framing: 2:3 vertical, wheel frontal and centered in upper half; all four medallions clearly separated and within 5% safe margin; X stone paths fill the lower third; open environment around the wheel supports later background cleanup.
Lighting/mood: quiet marine twilight with pearl-white highlights and restrained gold.
Color palette: deep sea blue, pearl white, warm gold.
Constraints: exactly one circular eight-spoke main wheel; no human faces, animals, duplicate wheels, duplicate seasonal emblems, numbers, text, frame, watermark, or distorted ellipse. Seasonal order is fixed: flowers top-left, sun top-right, leaves bottom-left, snowy forest bottom-right. Avoid floating path fragments.
generationRuns.conclusion: selected as master candidate; no transparent layers, model, viewer, or acceptance evidence yet
